boundary: Real DSH sessions, registered init/evaluation tools, persistent storage, Git linked worktrees, actual Python scoring and authenticated evaluation HTTP. No model calls, product edits or deadline adaptation.

probe.boundary: Current startup reconciliation with real Git, batch runner, gated shell task and real SIGKILL of only the owning Host. Automatic uses on-disk storage adapter and real product startup apply. Actual uses real DSH storage/tools and restarts with same DSH_HOME. No product source or deadline changes. A bounded six-second post-exit observation covers at least one configured five-second process-monitor interval; it does not claim an unlimited wait.
